questions.question_text: Translate triangle T by the vector (-2 7).
Reflect triangle T in the x-axis. Label the image P.
Reflect triangle T in the line x = -1. Label the image Q.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle P onto triangle Q.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle T onto triangle U.
In the diagram, ABC is a triangle and AB is parallel to DE. Angle BCA = 68° and DE = DC. Find angle BAC.
Choose one word from the list to complete the statement. Triangle ABC is scalene / equilateral / isosceles / right-angled.
Calculate the interior angle of a regular 20 sided polygon.
In the diagram, angle A = angle P and angle B = angle Q. Explain why angle C = angle R.
AB = 8 cm, AC = 5 cm, BC = 9 cm and PR = 3 cm. Complete the statement. Triangle ABC is ... to triangle PQR.
Calculate QR.
12 students take part in a quiz. The table shows the number of correct answers given by each student. Find the median.
Find the lower quartile.
Find the number of students with a smaller number of correct answers than the lower quartile.
The table shows the average monthly temperature and the average monthly rainfall in Maseru, Lesotho. What type of correlation is there between the monthly temperature and the monthly rainfall?
Find the range of these temperatures.
Find the mean of these temperatures.
Find the equation of the line of regression, giving r in terms of t.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of the regression line for 8 <= t <= 21.
Marie has $260.50 and Luk has $208.40. Find, in its simplest form, the ratio Marie’s money : Luk’s money.
Marie spends 16% of her money to buy a new coat. Calculate the cost of the coat.
In a sale, the prices of all books are reduced by 10%. Luk buys a book for $11.25. Calculate the original price of the book.
Marie invests $200 at a rate of 2% per year simple interest. Calculate the total value of this investment at the end of 25 years.
Luk invests $190 at a rate of 2% per year compound interest. Calculate the value of this investment at the end of 25 years.
Fredrik invests $120 at a rate of 5.7% per year compound interest. Calculate the number of complete years it will take until the value of this investment is first greater than $300.

The diagram shows a solid sphere of radius 4 cm inside a hollow cone of radius 8 cm and height 16 cm. The sphere touches the interior of the cone. Calculate the volume of the cone that is not occupied by the sphere.
Calculate the curved surface area of the cone.
The centre, O, of the sphere is directly above the vertex, V, of the cone. Calculate the length OV.
f(x) = x - 5 log x. On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for 0 < x <= 10.
Find the co-ordinates of the local minimum point.
Find the range of f(x) for the domain 1 <= x <= 5.
Solve the equation f(x) = 2.
Solve the inequality f(x) < 2.
Complete the statement. The y-axis is ... to the graph of y = f(x).
Calculate AB.
Calculate angle BCD.
Find the value of g(h(1)).
Simplify f(g(x)) + f(x).
Find h^(-1)(x).
Solve g(x) = 1.
Solve g^(-1)(x) = 1.

In a survey, 40 students are asked if they like football, F, and if they like baseball, B. 22 like football, 19 like baseball and 6 do not like either football or baseball. Complete the Venn diagram to show this information.
How many of these students like both football and baseball?
How many of these students either like football or do not like baseball?
Find n(F intersect B').
Two of these students are chosen at random. Find the probability that they both like football.
One of the 19 students who like baseball is chosen at random. Find the probability that this student also likes football.
Two of the 19 students who like baseball are chosen at random. Find the probability that one likes football and one does not like football.

Another n students take part in the survey. They all like both baseball and football. A student is then chosen at random from the (40 + n) students. The probability that a student likes both football and baseball is 5/16. Find the value of n.
On the Venn diagram, shade the region F' union B'.
The time, t hours, taken by each of 200 cars to complete a journey of 200 km is recorded. The results are shown in the table. Calculate an estimate of the mean.
On the grid, draw the histogram to show the information in the table.

One car completes the 200 km journey at an average speed of x km/h. Another car completes the 200 km journey at an average speed of (x + 10) km/h. The difference between the times taken by the two cars is 20 minutes. Show that x^2 + 10x - 6000 = 0.
Find the time taken for the slower journey. Give your answer in hours and minutes correct to the nearest minute.
In the diagram, OA = a and OB = b. M is the midpoint of AB and N is the midpoint of AM. Find AB in terms of a and b.
Find AN in terms of a and b.
Find ON in terms of a and b.
O is the point (0, 0). OA = (8 / 0) and OB = (2 / 6). Find the co-ordinates of N.
